title: Verify EUR title cursor choices under Wine
changes: Add one bounded ordinary title-selector interpreter comparison covering the five language cursor positions without confirming a language change.
validation: Wine e155-title-cursor-languages-wine-yx3vvt5x verifies both typed cursor halfwords for choices 0–4, zero raw source reads and equal raw/managed state and clock across 33 frames.
The first test build ec2ayc3l failed because a read length was declared u16 rather than usize; the corrected build c5alo8cq passed.
limitations: Native dispatch for the new choices, other bank entries, frontend UI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
